equilibrium.calibration_note: the cases declare only 'type nutUSpaldingWallFunction;', so the OpenFOAM Foundation 10 defaults kappa = 0.41, E = 9.8 apply and B = ln(E)/kappa = 5.5668.  The a-priori M0 is evaluated with THESE constants, not the Python ladder's B = 5.0 default; the difference is reported per point as spalding_calibration_sensitivity.

total_gradient_tble.calibration_note: totalGradientTbleNutFvPatchScalarField.C hard-codes kappa = 0.41 and Aplus = 26.0; these equal the Python ladder's KAPPA_MIXING and VAN_DRIEST_A, so M1 needs no calibration adjustment.

wall_model_identity.root_selection_note: M1 keeps the pinned r2m4 root policy (all sign-changing brackets resolved, the root closest to the Spalding continuation state selected).  That continuation seed uses the ladder's Spalding default; it is a root-selection device, not the model, and is left unchanged so this reduction stays comparable with the closed R2-m4 row.  roots_M1_max is reported per point.

critical_matching_height.why: the case under test is the Xiao Re_H=5600 periodic hill; its own row is periodic_hills_1p0.  krank_pehill_Re10595 is a different DNS at Re_H=10595 and its y_crit+ = 15.93 has no authority over this case.
critical_matching_height.statement: the a-priori relative error of this case exceeds unity already at the lower edge of the swept y+ grid, so y_crit+ = 1.0 is a grid-floor bound, not an interior crossing; all sampled coupled surfaces lie beyond it and the sweep therefore measures station dependence, not a window crossing
